title: Replit Introduces Free Mode to Expand What is Possible with AI
summary: AI models are now capable and affordable enough to make once-unreachable outcomes practical. The opportunity for everyone to pursue and collaborate on ambitious ideas, spend less time on busywork, and raise the quality and creative output across disciplines is nearly here. The possibility is here. But for most people, the reality is not. Replit users are already building million-dollar businesses, replacing legacy software and saving hundreds of thousands of dollars, and increasing their everyday potential by creating high-quality software, designs, slides, and more.
